skills.name: Storyteller
skills.summary: Writes detailed, uncommon video scripts: a hook, beat-by-beat narration and a visual prompt for every clip.
responsibilities: Picks an angle the audience has not seen before
Writes narration clip by clip within the word budget
Checks every line for clichés and repeated words
Saves the script to the project folder on GitHub

skills.name: AI Prompt Expert
skills.summary: Turns a script into clean, photoreal prompts for Google Flow and other AI video generators.
responsibilities: Writes one prompt per clip with no repeated words
Shows on screen what the narrator says
Keeps the on-screen character from dubbing the narrator
Keeps looks consistent with reusable character and place descriptions

skills.name: Video Editor
skills.summary: Edits and compiles the generated clips into one seamless video, in the right story order, with the voice-over in sync.
responsibilities: Works with Marites to learn the flow of the story and cuts the clips in the right sequence
Trims and matches every clip so the joins are seamless, with no glitch, pop or jump
Lays the voice-over on so each line lands on its own picture and finishes inside its clip
Measures the finished video for black or frozen frames, audio drift and out-of-sync narration
Hands the final video and its cut list to Perpekto for the quality check

skills.name: Flow Clip QA
skills.summary: Checks Google Flow clips and finished reels, then gives a pass or fail verdict with the cheapest fix.
responsibilities: Runs automatic checks for format, black or frozen frames and cut-off narration
Reviews contact sheets for wrong scenes, text, watermarks and garbled faces
Spots lip-sync dubbing and repeated words
Reports a verdict with evidence, and never posts or regenerates

skills.name: Portfolio Updater
skills.summary: Adds every delivered video or app to the right studio on the portfolio, with a NEW badge for its first week, and keeps the workflow and skills sections current.
responsibilities: Adds each delivered video or app to the portfolio
Classifies it into Ads, Kids, Stories or Applications
Shows a NEW badge for 7 days after it is published
Keeps each studio page, the workflow and the skills showcase up to date
Keeps analytics, the Tag Manager export and the Looker Studio guide in step, and lists the manual steps left
Watches everything happening in the owner's Claude projects and updates the portfolio when it changes
Adds or edits a teammate in The Team I built whenever a skill is added, named or changed
Updates the studio workflow pipelines when a project's instructions or video flow change
Pushes the update to the live branch and to gh-pages, and checks it
